claims.assertion: Mari Swaruu describes the universe as one timeless potential-energy field, likened to highly vibrational water, with consciousness generating forms and distinctions.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu

claims.assertion: She defines gravity as consciousness-attention flow that concentrates potential energy into mass, rather than mass producing gravity.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu

claims.assertion: She says coded harmonics create standing waves that form particles and give them unique attributes; apparent particle types are variations of one primordial field.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu

claims.assertion: She treats density realms and parallel universes as mental divisions of one whole; objects and time arise through consciousness-based numerical relations.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu

review_flags: Mari Swaruu explicitly contrasts her gravity model with conventional terrestrial physics.
